changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'graph' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetNode') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [graph].[AssetNode]( [ID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Properties] [xml] NULL, [Path] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Segments] [xml] NULL, [State] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Class] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_GraphAssetNode] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) AS NODE END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNode') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetNode] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( [UpdatedOn] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNode_AssetTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetNode_AssetTypeID] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNode_Class') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetNode_Class] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( [Class] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNode_Id') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetNode_Id] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( $node_id ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNode_Uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetNode_Uid] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( [Uid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.xml_indexes where name = 'IX_XML_GraphAssetNode_Segments_Primary') BEGIN CREATE PRIMARY XML INDEX [IX_XML_GraphAssetNode_Segments_Primary] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( [Segments] ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.xml_indexes where name = 'IX_XML_GraphAssetNode_Segments_Path') BEGIN CREATE XML INDEX [IX_XML_GraphAssetNode_Segments_Path] ON [graph].[AssetNode] ( [Segments] ) USING XML INDEX [IX_XML_GraphAssetNode_Segments_Primary] FOR PATH WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, DROP_EXISTING = OFF, ONLINE = OFF) END

changeSet.sql:

IF NOT EXISTS (select 1 from sys.columns c inner join sys.fulltext_index_columns f on f.object_id = c.object_id and f.column_id = c.column_id and c.name = 'Path' inner join sys.objects t on t.object_id = f.object_id and t.name = 'AssetNode') BEGIN ALTER FULLTEXT INDEX ON [graph].[AssetNode] ADD ([Path] LANGUAGE 1033) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select 1 from sys.columns c inner join sys.fulltext_index_columns f on f.object_id = c.object_id and f.column_id = c.column_id and c.name = 'Segments' inner join sys.objects t on t.object_id = f.object_id and t.name = 'AssetNode') BEGIN ALTER FULLTEXT INDEX ON [graph].[AssetNode] ADD ([Segments] LANGUAGE 1033) END
